answer: Recency-decayed standing resists sybils: each identity's weight falls off exponentially every epoch and is restored only by fresh verified work, so influence is a river that must be continuously refed, never a lake filled once. A dormant fleet of fakes bleeds to zero while its minting cost is already sunk; carrying an atlas of thousands means doing genuine work for each, forever. A lotus blooms only while tended, so idle swarms starve.
